_comment: docs/spec.md §3.2 — one example "AI" section per supported ChatClientFactory engine type. Copy the one you need into appsettings.json / appsettings.Development.json, or set the equivalent AI__* environment variables (Docker-friendly — see .env.example). Real secrets belong in environment variables or a secret store, never committed here. Ollama note: pull a tool-calling-capable model (llama3.1+, e.g. llama3.2) — plain llama3 has no tool-call template, so BudgetSkill would silently never fire (agent answers from general knowledge, empty activity log — looks like broken skill wiring, isn't).

AI_OpenAI_LMStudio._comment: ENDPOINT is optional for the OpenAI engine type — set it to point at any OpenAI-API-compatible local server instead of the real OpenAI API (LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp's server, ...). LM Studio's server doesn't check API_KEY, so any non-empty placeholder works.
